description: Pinned toolchains for layout/generate_array.sh, layout/generate_sense_latch.sh and the scaling builds in layout/extract_array_parasitics.sh (issues #91, #387). Read by layout/generation_toolchain.py; see layout/README.md 'Reproducing the committed array (issue #91)' and 'Sense latch (issue #387)'.

generation.purpose: klt gen mos_array + klt gen-compose: writes gain_cell_2t_array_mos.{gds,json} and gain_cell_2t_array.{gds,layout.json} for the array, and the sense latch's five blocks (sense_latch_{npair,ppair,footer,header}_mos.{gds,json}, sense_latch_ptap.{gds,json}) plus sense_latch.{gds,layout.json} via layout/generate_sense_latch.sh (issue #387) -- the latch reproduces its committed stream byte-for-byte under this pin (generate_sense_latch.sh --check)
generation.verified: Issue #244: klt 0.8.0 generators (gen mos_array, gen guard_ring, gen-compose) emit a layout that is DRC clean, LVS match, ERC clean under the 0.8.0 deck, and reproduce the committed array byte-for-byte; see layout/README.md 'DRC under klt 0.8.0'. Supersedes the 2dd24b09 (0.4.0) generation pin recorded in layout/results/generation_reproduction_20261011.json. Issue #275 moved the check pin to 0.9.1 (geometry then measured identical, issue #284, kept committed as history) and issue #388 moved it to 0.9.2, each time leaving this one at 0.8.0: every check release from 0.9.1 on renames the emitted sub-PCell structure (mos_array -> <cell-name>__core) and adds a dogbone_terminals PCell parameter, so 0.9.x generation does not reproduce the committed GDS byte-for-byte -- and under 0.9.2 it is no longer geometry-identical either: measured in layout/results/geometry_xor_klt0.9.2_vs_committed_20261121.json, of the 10 drawn layers (65/20, 65/44, 66/20, 66/44, 67/20, 67/44, 68/20, 93/44, 94/20, 95/20) only layer 95/20 has 0.2336 um^2 total XOR. Each of its 32 per-device markers grew from 0.36 x 0.36 um to 0.37 x 0.37 um (+5 nm per side), with no mos-report parameter difference. The other 9 pairs XOR empty, and the bounding box and the 33 labels (on the separate label-only pairs 67/5 and 68/5) are identical. The check pin re-checks the committed geometry and never redraws it -- DRC/LVS/ERC on the unchanged committed GDS stay clean/match/clean under 0.9.2 (see layout/README.md 'DRC/LVS/ERC under klt 0.9.2') and the 0.9.2-drawn scratch stream is clean/match/clean too, so the 95/20 change is a measured upstream generator change (surfaced in issue #388), one more reason generation stays pinned to the release that reproduces the committed GDS byte-for-byte. That measurement is re-derived inside this repo by layout/xor_layout_geometry.py -- layout/test_generation_reproducibility.py binds this field to that record. See layout/README.md 'Generation and check pins diverge at klt 0.9.1 (issues #275, #388)'.

check.purpose: klt drc / klt lvs / klt erc status gates. Same klayout-tools release as .github/workflows/signoff.yml KLT_VERSION (a PyPI pin, so no git commit), which produced the committed array DRC/LVS/ERC reports and the sense latch's DRC/LVS reports (klt_version 0.9.2, issues #387 and #388). Tracks the signoff pin, which is why it can differ from the generation pin above (issues #275 and #388).

pdk.note: Must equal sim/_evidence_common.py PDK_OPEN_PDKS_COMMIT and docs/pdk-pin.md (checked by layout/test_generation_reproducibility.py).
